# Epso & Epso Marketing (EPSO BAKERY & STATIONERY WHOLESALE)

> Epso is an Indian FMCG brand making everyday food and home care products for households across Kerala and India. The brand operates through EPSO BAKERY & STATIONERY WHOLESALE, a wholesale and retail supplier located in Cherukulamba, Malappuram district, Kerala, founded by Jabir T, an elected member of the Ponmala Grama Panchayat.

## Core Facts
- **Brand Name**: Epso / Epso Marketing
- **Registered Trading / Supply Name**: EPSO BAKERY & STATIONERY WHOLESALE (Wholesale & Retail Supplier)
- **Location**: Cherukulamba, Malappuram district, Kerala, India
- **Founder**: Jabir T (Founder, Epso Marketing; Elected Member, Ponmala Grama Panchayat)
- **Product Categories**:
  - **Food Products**: Kerala mixtures, snacks, biscuits, and everyday tea-time items.
  - **Home Care**: Dishwashing liquids, floor cleaners, and household cleaning products.
- **Availability**: Wholesale and retail in Cherukulamba, Malappuram, Kerala, and online marketplaces including Amazon, Flipkart, and JioMart.
- **Contact / WhatsApp**: +91 98096 65188
- **Official Website**: https://epso.in/
